name: Add To GitHub projects
description: Automatically add issues and PRs to GitHub projects

project-url.description: URL of the project to add issues to

github-token.description: A GitHub personal access token with write access to the project

labeled.description: A comma-separated list of labels to use as a filter for issue to be added

label-operator.description: The behavior of the labels filter, AND to match all labels, OR to match any label, NOT to exclude any listed label (default is OR)
